findings.note: _cmd_assemble discards the current manifest version returned by _capture_closure and _reviewed_drift serializes using only the reviewed snapshot metadata. A schema-valid, digest-approved inventory can therefore claim a bundle_version different from the captured manifest and still assemble successfully. Compare reviewed snapshot.bundle_version with the current manifest version before any destination write; add a mismatch test.

The hand-rolled verifier accepts duplicate JSON object keys (json.loads keeps the last value) and does not enforce the contract's ascending files order. It can report an inventory as intact despite malformed/ambiguous or nonconforming inventory bytes when the marker matches. Reject duplicate keys and validate ordering; add verifier malformed-input cases.

Manual acceptance remains open: real-tree inventory/assembly and preservation (T029), checkout-independent verification (T030), packaged install and neutral-default checks (T033-T034), update matrix (T036), human docs review/walkthrough (T039-T040), boundary/scan positive-control sweeps (T041-T042), and traceability closure (T044). Fixture tests do not establish these results; keep them reported as unverified until completed.
